Definition: from G4108; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher:--wandering.
BiblicalUsage: Planetes is a wandering star, a planet that roams from its course. Jude uses it once, in Jude 1:13, for false teachers: wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a star that leaves its course is not free — it is lost, and its end is darkness.
